verdict.rationale: Decagon's overview claims technical teams keep "full visibility and control over... versioning" of agents (decagon-docs-1/25). Pre-deploy validation comes from Simulations, run before production and "with every subsequent update" (decagon-docs-29), and from Experiments with traffic splits against a stable control group (decagon-docs-7/32), which loosely supports reviewing changes before full rollout. Missing for 10: any documented rollback or revert-to-prior-version capability, a described change-review/approval workflow or version diffing, detail beyond a single one-word versioning mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
